name: request_tool
description: Ask the owner to turn on one tool that is currently off, when the task cannot be done without it. Give the reason in one short sentence. The tool stays off in this request: finish your answer and say what you would do with it. The owner may turn it on and continue. Tools you can ask for: web_search - search the public web; read_page - read a public web page; inspect_image - ask the model about a public image; profile_information - find the app's profiles, devices and saved tunnels; http_get - read private responses from a saved Web tunnel; mqtt_read - read private messages already observed by a connected MQTT explorer; mqtt_publish - publish a message to a saved MQTT connection; start_tunnel - start and stop the owner's saved tunnels; terminal_tabs - read and rename the owner's open terminal tabs; terminal_input - type into the owner's open terminal tabs; terminal_open - open and use its own terminal sessions; skills_list - save and delete the owner's skills; wait_for - wait in the background for tab, tunnel and time events; ssh_command - run one command through a saved SSH tunnel.
